title: Peakstone Realty Trust 8-K Filing — 2026-04-30
summary: Peakstone Realty Trust shareholders approved a merger with entities affiliated with Brookfield and BSREP V at a special meeting on April 29, 2026. The merger proposal passed with approximately 97.4% of votes cast in favor (21.8 million shares for vs. 304,887 against). This is a routine SEC Form 8-K filing reporting the outcome of a shareholder vote on a corporate M&A transaction.
key_points: Peakstone Realty Trust (ticker: PKST, listed on NYSE) announced results of shareholder vote on merger agreement dated February 2, 2026
Merger partners are BSREP V Neon Pooling REIT L.P., BSREP V Neon Pooling Non-REIT L.P., and BSREP V Brookfield Neon Sub L.P. (affiliates of Brookfield/Blackstone)
Merger Proposal passed: 21,848,801 for, 304,887 against, 288,066 abstentions
Executive compensation advisory proposal passed: 16,360,800 for, 5,655,446 against
Record date: March 13, 2026; quorum present with 60.34% of shares represented (22.4 million of 37.2 million outstanding)
CFO Javier F. Bitar signed the filing on April 30, 2026
